purpose: Turn a setting between on and off states with immediate toggle semantics.
useWhen: A setting has two mutually exclusive on and off states.
Changing the state can take effect immediately.

avoidWhen.situation: The boolean value is submitted as part of a form or represents acknowledgement.
Users must choose one value from more than two named options.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use a radio group or select.

supportedInteractions: Pointer and keyboard toggle through React Aria
approvedPatterns: Provide a concise label describing the setting.
Use controlled state when surrounding content must react to the setting.
Choose appearance default or subtle and size sm, md, or lg for the surrounding density.
limitations: The component represents only binary on and off state.
The selected checkmark appears only for appearance default.
Track and handle internals are private.
style overrides are not supported and className is intended for outer layout.
accessibility: Uses React Aria Switch semantics with keyboard, focus, selected, disabled, and read-only behavior.
The visible label is part of the switch control.
responsive: The control is inline-flex; place multiple switches in a responsive grid or vertical stack.
rtl: Logical positioning mirrors the handle in RTL layouts.
The default selected checkmark also follows the active direction.
